# infoblox_awsuser (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox Awsuser from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific AWS User by filters
data "infoblox_awsuser" "aws_user_by_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "aws-user"
  }
}

// Retrieve all AWS Users
data "infoblox_awsuser" "get_all_aws_users" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.
- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (String) The unique Access Key ID of this AWS user. Maximum 255 characters.
- `account_id` (String) The AWS Account ID of this AWS user. Maximum 64 characters.
- `govcloud_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if gov cloud is enabled or disabled.
- `name` (String) The AWS user name. Maximum 64 characters.
- `nios_user_name` (String) The NIOS user name mapped to this AWS user. Maximum 64 characters.
- `secret_access_key` (String) The Secret Access Key for the Access Key ID of this user. Maximum 255 characters.
